subject: mathematics
concept: Identifying right angles and comparing angles as bigger or smaller than a right angle
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student uses a virtual corner-tester (square tile) to check angles on shapes
exercise.pictorial: Student sorts pictured angles into 'right angle', 'smaller', or 'bigger'
exercise.abstract: Student identifies angle type from a written or drawn description

misconception_flags: judges angle size by the length of the lines rather than the opening between them

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
